query:
SELECT
                u.user_id,
                u.github_login,
                COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), u.github_login) AS "public_name!"
            FROM users u
            ORDER BY
                LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), u.github_login)) ASC,
                LOWER(u.github_login) ASC,
                u.user_id ASC
            LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2
